drawer.generalBody: Search the Help Center for step-by-step guides, or take the tour to learn the basics.

welcome.title: Welcome to FacilityPro
welcome.body: This short tour shows you where everything is. It takes about a minute — you can skip it and restart it any time from Help.

welcomeTenant.title: Welcome to FacilityPro
welcomeTenant.body: Here you can report anything broken in your building and follow it until it is fixed. This tour takes under a minute.

menu.title: The menu
menu.body: Every module is here, grouped into Maintenance, Operations, Financial and Settings. Click a group name to fold it away.

myWork.title: My work
myWork.body: The work orders assigned to you. Open one to start it, log parts and time, fill in its checklist and mark it resolved.

stats.title: Your numbers at a glance
stats.body: Total and pending work, assets and recently completed jobs. Overdue work shows as a red banner above them.

create.title: Create anything
create.body: Report a fault, or add an asset, part, location, vendor, maintenance plan or checklist from this one button.

org.title: Organisation and role
org.body: The organisation you're working in and your role in it. Your role decides which pages and actions you see.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.body: New assignments, status changes, approvals and IoT alerts arrive here. Choose email, SMS or push under Security.

language.title: Language
language.body: Switch between English and Tiếng Việt at any time. Your choice is remembered.

help.title: Help on every page
help.body: Click Help to see what the current page does and what its fields mean, with a link to the full guide.

reportFault.title: Report a fault
reportFault.body: Tell us what's wrong and where. Add a photo if you can — it helps the technician bring the right parts.

myRequests.title: My requests
myRequests.body: Everything you have reported, with its current status: New, Assigned, In progress, Resolved…

finish.title: You're ready
finish.body: That's the tour. The User guide in the menu has step-by-step instructions for every feature.

center.title: Help Center
center.subtitle: Step-by-step guides for every part of FacilityPro, with screenshots from the app.
